name: Juncigenaceae

img.author: Poli A, Bovio E, Verkley G, Prigione V, Varese GC (2019) Elbamycella rosea gen. et sp. nov. (Juncigenaceae, Torpedosporales) isolated from the Mediterranean Sea. MycoKeys 55: 15-28. https://doi.org/10.3897/mycokeys.55.35522

desc: Juncigenaceae is a family of ascomycetous marine based fungi within the order of Torpedosporales in the subclass Hypocreomycetidae and within the class Sordariomycetes.
